watch.summary: The creator laughs hysterically as a sad fan in an esports crowd instantly changes her expression upon realizing she is on camera.

beats.what: Crowd footage shows a girl looking distressed and emotional.
The girl notices she is on the big screen and instantly fixes her face.
The creator bursts into laughter at the instant expression switch.
The creator acts out her internal thought process of wanting to look pretty.

watch.author: mixed
watch.key_line: She's like ah, gotta look pretty.
watch.why: The clip relies on a universally relatable visual gag of someone catching themselves on camera and instantly posing. The streamer's quick imitation and loud laugh deliver a great comedic punch.
